description:
After a claim is registered, it is examined by a claims officer.
The claims officer then writes a settlement recommendation.
This recommendation is then checked by a senior claims officer who may mark the claim as OK or Not OK.
If the claim is marked as Not OK, it is sent back to the claims officer and the recommendation is repeated.
If the claim is OK, the claim handling process proceeds.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ClaimHandling" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/claim-handling">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim Review Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ClaimReview">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RewriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior Claims Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkClaimOK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ClaimOK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkClaimNotOK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisteredToExamine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisteredToExamine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExamineToWrite</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExamineToWrite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WriteToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecommendationMerge" name="Recommendation submitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WriteToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RewriteToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Check settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimDecision" name="Claim marked OK or Not OK?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OK</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotOK</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MarkClaimOK" name="Mark claim OK">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OK</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MarkOKToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClaimOK" name="Claim OK, claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MarkOKToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MarkClaimNotOK" name="Mark claim Not OK">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotOK</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MarkNotOKToReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnClaim" name="Send claim back to claims officer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MarkNotOKToReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToRewrite</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RewriteRecommendation" name="Repeat settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToRewrite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RewriteToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisteredToExamine" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExamineToWrite" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToMerge" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RewriteToMerge" sourceRef="Task_RewriteRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OK" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimDecision" targetRef="Task_MarkClaimOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MarkOKToEnd" sourceRef="Task_MarkClaimOK" targetRef="EndEvent_ClaimOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotOK" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimDecision" targetRef="Task_MarkClaimNotOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MarkNotOKToReturn" sourceRef="Task_MarkClaimNotOK" targetRef="Task_ReturnClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToRewrite" sourceRef="Task_ReturnClaim" targetRef="Task_RewriteRecommendation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
